sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美西语近岸软件研发外包与数字客服中心

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Publishing of Massively Multiplayer Online Role-Playing Games

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law 526 of 1999 (UIAF creation); Law 1121 of 2006 (AML/CFT regime); Decree 830 of 2021 (Beneficial Owner Registry); Resolution 164 of 2022 (Superintendencia de Sociedades UBO disclosure obligations); Decree 1674 of 2016 (harmonization with FATF Recommendations); Circular Básica Jurídica of the Superintendencia Financiera (SARLAFT framework).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of the passport of each ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary or competent issuing authority in the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of good standing and apostilled corporate composition of any non-resident corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign company registry (e.g., Registrar of Companies, Companies House)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized power of attorney granted to the legal representative domiciled in Colombia
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Public Notary in the country of execution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization for non-Hague signatory states

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation screening of all shareholders, directors, and UBOs against the OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List, and Colombian domestic lists (Lista CONVIVE and Lista Clinton administered by the UIAF). Ongoing transaction- and counterparty-level screening under the SARLAFT compliance manual must be embedded in the S.A.S. bylaws and operational procedures from day one.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) via the Portal Empresarial of the Cámara de Comercio of the chosen domicile (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá for the principal MMORPG development hub).
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All proposed corporate names must be expressed in Spanish using Latin script. Foreign-origin trademarks or stylized names are transliterated into a phonetically equivalent Latin-character Spanish rendering; the final corporate denomination must be stated entirely in Spanish in the bylaws and in the certificate of incorporation.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: BANCO (requires prior authorization of Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia)
FINANCIERA (requires prior authorization of Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia)
ASEGURADORA (requires prior authorization of Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia)
SEGUROS (requires prior authorization of Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia)
NACIONAL (prohibited unless the state is a shareholder)
COOPERATIVA (reserved for cooperative entities under mutual law)
FONDO DE PENSIONES (reserved for licensed pension fund vehicles)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection, the incorporator shall file a recurso de reposición (reconsideration appeal) before the executing Cámara de Comercio within 10 business days of notification, annexing a revised name memorandum demonstrating absence of homonymy and trademark conflict; if denied, the applicant may escalate via recurso de apelación to the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio within 5 business days following the Chamber's decision. Extended reservations are not statutorily available beyond the 30-day window; re-filing is required thereafter.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office arrangements are accepted for the S.A.S. MMORPG licensing structure provided that a fixed registered address within Colombian territory is maintained for tax domicile and service of process. A commercial sub-registration agreement with a licensed serviced-office provider satisfies the registered-office requirement for this digital publishing scope; no dedicated physical establishment is required.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low_Probability_10_Percent – unannounced on-site inspections are materially triggered only by VAT or municipal tax inconsistencies, cash-intensive operations, or formal employment violations; the ISIC 5820 global MMORPG publishing model presents minimal inspection exposure.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name availability certificate (certificado de homonimia) issued by the Chamber of Commerce
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the domicile

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization of the S.A.S. private incorporation instrument (documento privado) and the corporate bylaws (estatutos)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Public Notary of the registered-office circuit
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: National notary tariff schedule (Decreto de aranceles notariales)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Mercantile registration fee of the S.A.S. in the Registro Mercantil
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Law 1429 of 2010 registration-rights formula based on declared share capital (minimum bracket)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Hague Apostille legalization of UBO passports and corporate good-standing certificates (2 document bundles)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Foreign Affairs or competent authorities of the issuing jurisdictions
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory apostille fee benchmark (USD 30 per document bundle)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting of S.A.S. bylaws, UBO piercing declaration, and SARLAFT compliance annex
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing Colombian market benchmark for comprehensive S.A.S. pre-incorporation compliance packages

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada regime), Código de Comercio arts. 98-129 and 142, Decree 1074 de 2015 (mercantil registry), Decree 19 de 2012 (administrative formalization), and Law 2069 de 2020 (corporate simplification and digital incorporation)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Superintendencia de Sociedades (supervisory oversight); local Cámara de Comercio (mercantil registry and commercial registration), e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá for a Bogotá D.C. seat
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (private incorporation document) executed by all shareholders with notarized signature authentication, filed for mercantil registration at the Cámara de Comercio
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital for a S.A.S.; authorized, subscribed and paid-in capital are freely defined in the bylaws. Cash contributions may be paid in installments subject to the bylaws payment schedule; no escrow account requirement applies to capital contributions of a S.A.S. covering software publishing activities.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: Be it resolved: (1) That the shares subscribed by the incorporating shareholder(s), as set forth in clause X of the bylaws, are hereby accepted and the corresponding capital is credited as subscribed and paid in accordance with the payment schedule. (2) That the registered office of the Company is established at [address], Bogotá D.C., Colombia, and the President is authorized to execute the lease agreement and file address changes with the Cámara de Comercio. (3) That the following persons are appointed: the legal representative (Presidente) and the Alternate Officer [name], with powers set out in Article Y; the Secretary is authorized to obtain the NIT/RUT, open bank accounts, and carry out all statutory filings.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá - Registry and Registration Department (or the local Chamber competent for the registered seat)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File a certificate of homonimia (name availability request) at the Chamber window or through its online portal, listing up to three proposed names in descending preference; the Chamber issues a certificate of non-coincidence valid for 60 days. Attach the identification copy of the incorporator(s).
required_dossiers: Completed homonimia request form
Copy of identification document of each incorporator (cédula or passport)
Proposed corporate names list (3 alternatives)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If one or more proposed names are rejected, the Chamber issues a written report citing the identical or confusingly similar registered trademark or company name; the applicant simply re-submits the homonimia form with new alternatives at no additional charge before the 60-day validity expires.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Notarization of the Private Incorporation Document (S.A.S. Bylaws)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public of the chosen corporate seat; subsequent filing at the Cámara de Comercio
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Documento Privado de Constitución containing the S.A.S. bylaws: name, domicile, corporate purpose (ISIC 5820 software publishing), capital clauses (authorized, subscribed, paid-in), representation powers, appointment of the legal representative, and dispute-resolution provisions. All shareholders must sign before a notary to authenticate their signatures; if aportes include real property, use a public deed instead of a private document.
required_dossiers: Statutory text of the S.A.S. (estatutos) with the clauses required by Ley 1258 de 2008
Identification documents of all founding shareholders
Name availability certificate (certificado de homonimia)
Evidence of payment or in-kind valuation of subscribed shares
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary returns the document with observations (e.g., inconsistent identification data, missing legal representation clause), correct the instrument and re-authenticate the signatures; rectification does not invalidate the homonimia certificate, which remains valid for the 60-day term.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Mercantil Registration and Matrícula Mercantil Issuance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá - Mercantil Registry (Registro Mercantil) and Matrícula Mercantil section
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the notarized incorporation document together with the completed registration form (Formulario de Matrícula Mercantil) and pay the registration and matriculation fee (tarifa based on the subscribed capital and number of documents). The Chamber reviews compliance, issues the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal, and activates the permanent matrícula mercantil of the company and its legal representative.
required_dossiers: Documento Privado de Constitución (notarized signatures of all shareholders)
Certificado de homonimia issued by the same Chamber
Standard registration form (formulario de registro / matrícula mercantil)
Bank or cash payment receipt of registry fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry enters a formal observation (e.g., missing page numbers, uncertified signature, unpaid fee), the applicant has the statutory term to cure within the file; if the registration is rejected, the company must refile the corrected document and pay only the refiling administration fee, preserving the filing date where the cure is timely.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration with DIAN (Assignation of NIT and RUT)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Unidad Administrativa Especial Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) - RUT and NIT offices
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within 10 calendar days after the mercantil registration, file the RUT (Registro Único Tributario) online at the DIAN portal (muisca.dian.gov.co) or at a DIAN support point; present the incorporation certificate, provide the legal representative's data, fiscal address, and the company's authorized representative. DIAN assigns the NIT and issues the RUT with the applicable tax obligations (income tax, ICA, VAT if applicable).
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal issued by the Cámara de Comercio
Copy of the bylaws and the designation of legal representative
Valid identification of the legal representative
Proof of the registered fiscal address (utility bill or lease agreement)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN returns the RUT procedure with observations (e.g., inconsistencies in the fiscal address or responsible regime), the applicant must correct the RUT form online and attach the missing evidence; if the NIT is cancelled or a duplicate exists, request the reactivation of the tax registry before the DIAN territorial directorate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Bank Account Opening and Capital Contribution Payment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (oversight of financial entities) and the chosen commercial bank
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a corporate bank account in the S.A.S. name using the NIT and the registry certificate; deposit the subscribed paid-in capital or evidence the capital payment schedule. For foreign direct investment inflows, register the investment in the Banco de la República's foreign exchange registration system within the statutory term and keep the bank deposit certificates as proof of contribution for tax and accounting purposes.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal (Chamber of Commerce, recent)
RUT and NIT certificate from DIAN
Bylaws and minutes appointing the legal representative
KYC/AML bank forms and ownership charts (including ultimate beneficial owner declarations)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requests supplemental KYC (e.g., proof of funds or beneficial ownership), supply the economic source declaration and UBO chart within the bank's deadline; if the bank rejects the account due to incomplete due diligence, initiate the procedure with an alternative commercial bank while maintaining the evidence file for the capital contribution obligation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Registration Employer and Social Security Registrations (ARL, EPS, Pension, Caja de Compensación)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Administradora de Riesgos Laborales (ARL), EPS, pension fund administrator, and Caja de Compensación Familiar in the workplace location
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the S.A.S. as an employer in the Sistema de Seguridad Social Integral through the RUAF (Registro Único de Aportes al Sistema de Seguridad Social) using the PILA planilla; enroll with the ARL for workplace-risk insurance, an EPS for workplace health benefits, a pension fund, and the Caja de Compensación Familiar (covering SENA and ICBF parafiscal contributions). Provide the workplace address and the payroll of the first employees.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal from the Cámara de Comercio
RUT issued by DIAN with employer status
Identification documents of the legal representative
Workplace lease contract or property title with occupational safety conditions
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If any entity rejects the employer registration due to data mismatches (e.g., address mismatch between RUT and ARL), correct the RUAF/PILA record and resubmit; attendance to the competent territorial labor authority resolves persistent conflicts arising from the employee's prior affiliations or payroll discrepancies.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable - ISIC 5820 (software publishing and MMORPG digital operations) is not an industrial activity requiring an industrial license; the Dirección Nacional de Derechos de Autor (DNDA) is the optional voluntary registry for software copyright protection under Law 1915 de 2018
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No mandatory operational or manufacturing permit for ISIC 5820; optional voluntary Registro de Software ante la Dirección Nacional de Derechos de Autor and a municipal land-use certificate (Certificado de Uso de Suelos) issued by the local planning authority for the office premises

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) and the territorial environmental authority, e.g., Secretaría Distrital de Ambiente of Bogotá D.C.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - office-based digital publishing, software development, and cloud MMORPG operations require no environmental license or EIA study; only general urban environmental compliance applies
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable; no industrial wastewater or VOC discharge thresholds apply to ISIC 5820. The S.A.S. must still comply with municipal solid-waste management rules, noise standards under Resolution 0627 de 2006 (maximum 65 dBA day / 55 dBA night in commercial zones), and e-waste disposal if hardware is used; any personal-data processing is regulated under Law 1581 de 2012.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire-safety and civil-defense clearance: obtain the certificate of human safety conditions against fire (Certificado de Condiciones de Seguridad Humana contra Incendios) from the official fire department for the leased office; municipal structural land-use approval (Certificado de Uso de Suelos) verifying seismic and structural load adequacy; occupational-health clearance through the SG-SST System (Resolución 0312 de 2019) with workplace risk inspection and employee emergency/evacuation plan.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN); portal: https://www.dian.gov.co; transactional portal: https://muisca.dian.gov.co
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A Colombian SAS obtains its Número de Identificación Tributaria (NIT) upon incorporation by filing the Certificate of Existence and Representation (Cámara de Comercio) and registering with DIAN through the RUT (Registro Único Tributario) procedure. Foreign entities without local presence need a Colombian appointed representative or attorney-in-fact to register for a NIT/VAT ID via the same RUT process, physically or through an authorized online intermediary, and must submit common corporate documents (certified copy of the deed/charter, power of attorney, foreign registration evidence, identification of legal representative) translated into Spanish and apostilled, if required.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box elections exist under Colombian tax law; corporate income tax (Impuesto sobre la Renta) is imposed at the entity level. An eligible S.A.S. may voluntarily opt into the 'Régimen Simple de Tributación' (RST), an elective special tax regime for small and medium entities, which substitutes CREE and some consumption withholding taxes. Hybrid mismatch regulations (Law 2010 of 2019) are mandatory and not elective, mandating jurisdictional tax characterization consistency for structured arrangements.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Legal entities, including S.A.S., have no turnover threshold and must register for VAT upon commencement of any taxable activity. Natural persons and informal entities become VAT responsible when their annual gross income exceeds 3,500 UVT (approx. COP 174 million for UVT 2025 valued at COP 49,799) or when otherwise meeting the qualitative nexus criteria in Article 437 of the Colombian Tax Statute.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Colombia mandates electronic invoicing (facturación electrónica) for all VAT-registered taxpayers with real-time pre-clearance (validación previa) through DIAN's technological platform. Invoices must be generated using DIAN-authorised software or the free DIAN portal, digitally signed with an XAdES-EPES signature, include a compulsory QR code generated by DIAN, and be transmitted as XML. At the point of sale, real-time receiver acknowledgement from DIAN is generally required before the operation is legally perfected; non-compliant invoicing triggers penalties and the denial of input VAT credits.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT applies to exports of goods and to services supplied for use or exploitation exclusively outside Colombia, provided the recipient is a non-resident, the service is not linked to subsequent local services, and the exporter obtains an official 'Exports of Services' certificate (Constancia de Exportación de Servicios) and complies with DIAN's documentary evidence requirements. For software and MMORPG in-app purchase activities, the exporter must evidence that the digital service is effectively consumed abroad, that intellectual property rights remain or are licensed to a foreign counterparty, and that the service is reflected in the exporter's periodic VAT declarations as zero-rated export income. Pure online services to foreign platforms qualify for zero-rating, but services linked to domestic end-consumers or related-party use may be taxed at 19% and subject to income tax source rules.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration, Bill of Lading, Inward Remittance Certificate
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN audits export zero-rating claims using cross-border data exchanges and transfer pricing documentation under Articles 260-2 and 260-3 of the Tax Statute. Failure to repatriate export proceeds within 180 days results in full VAT recapture (clawback) plus monetary interest and a penalty of up to 160% of the tax previously zero-rated, invoiced by a formal assessment. Falsifying the export documentation or misrepresenting the offshore recipient triggers criminal penalties under Law 599 of 2000 (Criminal Code) for fraud, in addition to tax fraud penalties under Article 647 of the Tax Statute; retrospective clawback is not statute-barred for fraudulent or sham transactions, and senior management and export document preparers can be held jointly liable.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia (Central Bank of Colombia), with Foreign Exchange Directorate (Dirección de Cambios Internacionales) administering the exchange control regime under the legal framework of Law 9 of 1991, Decree 1735 of 1993, Resolution 8 of 2000 and the External Communications (Comunicaciones Externas DCIP); exchange transactions must be channeled through authorized intermediaries (Intermediarios del Mercado Cambiario – IMC) and be reported in the Sistema de Información Cambiaria for registration.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: COP is freely convertible on the current account for operating transactions; Colombia maintains a managed exchange-control regime for capital account operations. The MMORPG publishing entity receives hard currency (USD/EUR) settlement from Apple and Google: these are service exports (exportación de servicios) that must be channeled through the IMC and registered in the Foreign Exchange Declaration (Declaración de Cambio). Profit remittance to shareholders is permitted only if the foreign investment has been registered in the International Investment Register (Registro Internacional de Inversiones) maintained by Banco de la República; dividends may be remitted via IMC after the corporate income tax and the dividend tax (going to non-residents) are settled and the investment registration is active. Unregistered foreign shareholding results in non-registrable capital outflows, including dividend remittances and capital repatriation, so the FDI registration step is mandatory within the treasury blueprint.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Export proceeds from the exploitation of software and publishing services must be channeled through the IMC within 6 months of accrual (Decree 1735/1993, Article 75); the foreign currency so obtained must be monetized (sold/converted into COP) within 5 business days of receipt, unless the exporter applies the proceeds to an authorized foreign payment purpose (payment of external credits, import settlements, or a permitted foreign currency obligation). A Foreign Exchange Declaration (Formulario de Declaración de Cambio - Exportación de Servicios) must be filed with the IMC for each batch of receipts. The statutory conversion ratio is 100% of net export revenue (gross proceeds minus app-store commissions deducted by Apple/Google, evidenced by payout statements) and the proceeds are exempt from the obligation after the 6-month term if properly channeled but still require the declaration. Failure to channel within the term triggers fines by the Superintendencia Financiera / tax consequences, although small service exporters under the threshold may qualify for simplified declaration procedures in the IMC.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual renewal of commercial registration (Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the registered domicile
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No later than March 31 of every calendar year; not anniversary-based.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal triggers overdue-interest charges on the renewal tariff and administrative fines; sustained non-renewal may lead to cancellation of the commercial registration and loss of registry-certificate evidence.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual filing of financial statements with the Commercial Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio through its digital document registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before March 31 of the year following the December 31 fiscal year-end.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: The Chamber of Commerce will not renew the matrícula mercantil if the financial statements are not filed; the company may be marked as non-compliant in the commercial registry and face deregistration procedures.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Ordinary annual general meeting and approval of annual accounts
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Corporate records maintained at the registered office; not generally filed unless specifically requested
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within the first three months of each calendar year under Código de Comercio Article 422.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Directors may incur personal liability for failing to call the meeting or to submit unapproved financial statements; unapproved accounts cannot be registered or filed with the Chamber.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return and supporting annexes
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Set by annual DIAN resolution; for calendar-year taxpayers, the corporate return generally falls between July 20 and August 27 based on the NIT ending digit.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing incurs a penalty of 5% of the tax payable plus default interest calculated from the due date; persistent non-filing may trigger DIAN tax-embargo proceedings and suspension of tax operations.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual beneficial owner report (Reporte de Beneficiario Final)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN through the Beneficiario Final electronic module
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by March 31; any transfer resulting in a change of beneficial ownership or control above 10% must be reported within 30 calendar days.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file or materially false information may lead to DIAN penalties under the Colombian tax code and undermine the company's AML/CFT compliance posture.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A revisor fiscal (statutory auditor) is mandatory if at year-end total assets exceed 5,000 times the monthly minimum wage (approx. USD 1.6 million in 2024) or gross revenues exceed 3,000 times the monthly minimum wage (approx. USD 1 million), or if the SAS qualifies as a public-interest entity under Decreto 2420/2015.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as implemented in Colombia by Decreto 2420/2015: Grupo 1 applies full IFRS; Grupo 2 applies IFRS for SMEs; Grupo 3 applies the simplified framework. A non-listed SAS in this scope typically applies Grupo 2 / IFRS for SMEs.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Every SAS must confirm and update its final beneficial owner information through the DIAN Beneficiario Final module by March 31 each year even if no shareholding changes occurred. Share transfers that create or change beneficial ownership above 10% must be reported within 30 days; the SAS must contemporaneously update its Register of Members and preserve supporting transfer minutes.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Libro de Registro de Accionistas)
Register of Directors / Board Minutes (Libro de Actas de Junta Directiva)
Minute Book of Shareholders' Meetings (Libro de Actas de Asamblea de Accionistas)
Accounting books and supporting vouchers (Libros de contabilidad)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,000 - USD 7,500 per year if the revisor fiscal threshold is triggered

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 35% general CIT rate in force for tax year 2023 and later (Law 2277 of 2022; 34% for tax year 2022; 33% for TY 2021; 9% sector surcharges for financial and hydrocarbon sectors not applicable to ISIC 5820); no municipal corporate income tax.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: (i) 'Economía Naranja' reduced 25% CIT rate for the first five tax years for qualifying newly incorporated creative-software/video-game companies, subject to Law 1955 of 2019 conditions and contemporaneous proof of the economic activity; (ii) VAT exclusion, not CIT reduction, for exported informatics and related services resulting from app-store payouts collected abroad; (iii) standard deductions (platform commissions to Apple/Google, hosting, wages, depreciation/amortization of capitalized development costs); (iv) losses carryforward 12 years; and (v) mandatory 15% minimum effective CIT floor for 'large taxpayers' (Law 2277/2022) which caps the benefit of exemptions/deductions for taxpayers classified as grandes contribuyentes.
